t.eng-ummmuhammad: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer
[It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent

ayahs.arabic: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years
So be patient with gracious patience
Indeed, they see it [as] distant
But We see it [as] near
On the Day the sky will be like murky oil
And the mountains will be like wool
And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend

ayahs.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.translit: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
And his wife and his brother
And his nearest kindred who shelter him

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.translit: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him
No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]
A remover of exteriors
It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
And collected [wealth] and hoarded
Indeed, mankind was created anxious
When evil touches him, impatient
And when good touches him, withholding [of it]
Except the observers of prayer
Those who are constant in their prayer
And those within whose wealth is a known right
For the petitioner and the deprived
And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe
And those who guard their private parts

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.translit: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.translit: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors
And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
And those who are in their testimonies upright
And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer
They will be in gardens, honored
So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]
[To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups

ayahs.arabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure
No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.translit: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised
